name: octanemcpplus
description: Model Context Protocol bridge for Octane Studio (2021 Luau)

tools.name: get_status
tools.description: Check if Octane Studio is connected and reports heartbeat status.

tools.name: execute_luau
tools.description: Evaluate arbitrary Luau code inside Octane Studio edit mode.

tools.name: read_script
tools.description: Read the source code of any Script, LocalScript, or ModuleScript.

tools.name: write_script
tools.description: Update or create scripts with new Luau code.

tools.name: get_tree
tools.description: Inspect the DataModel hierarchy under any root (e.g. Workspace, ReplicatedStorage).

tools.name: get_selection
tools.description: Get instances currently selected in Explorer or 3D viewport.

tools.name: set_selection
tools.description: Select instances by path in Octane Studio.

tools.name: create_instance
tools.description: Create new Instances (Part, Model, Folder, RemoteEvent, etc.) with properties.

tools.name: delete_instance
tools.description: Destroy an instance at a given path.

tools.name: get_properties
tools.description: Read specified properties of an instance.
